release_notes: The Bosch AUTODOME IP dynamic 7000 HD is a 1080p IP PTZ speed dome on Bosch's CPP4 platform, with a 1/2.8-inch Exmor CMOS, 30x optical zoom, 90 dB multiple-exposure HDR, and Intelligent Tracking with on-board Intelligent Video Analytics.
